function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Access Privilege Revocation Status Checker

Queries the access management system to check the revocation status
of privileges for offboarded employees.

Usage:
    python check_revocation.py [--format json]
"""

import json
import sys
import argparse
from pathlib import Path


def load_offboarding_list():
    """Load the list of employees being offboarded."""
    data_dir = Path(__file__).parent / "data"
    csv_path = data_dir / "offboarding_list.csv"
    
    if not csv_path.exists():
        print(f"Error: {csv_path} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    
    employees = []
    with open(csv_path, 'r') as f:
        # Skip header
        next(f)
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                parts = line.split(',')
                if len(parts) >= 1:
                    employees.append(parts[0].strip())
    
    return employees


def check_privilege_status():
    """
    Query the access management system for privilege revocation status.
    
    In a real system, this would make API calls to the access management backend.
    For this demo, we return hardcoded ground truth data.
    """
    
    employees = load_offboarding_list()
    
    privileges = []
    
    for emp_id in employees:
        for system in ["vpn", "gitlab", "wiki"]:
            if emp_id == "emp_008" and system == "vpn":
                status = "active"
            elif emp_id == "emp_009" and system == "gitlab":
                status = "scheduled"
            else:
                status = "revoked"
            
            privileges.append({
                "employee_id": emp_id,
                "system": system,
                "status": status,
                "last_access": "2026-09-01" if status == "revoked" else "2026-09-07"
            })
    
    # Calculate statistics
    total = len(privileges)
    revoked_count = sum(1 for p in privileges if p["status"] == "revoked")
    scheduled_count = sum(1 for p in privileges if p["status"] == "scheduled")
    active_count = sum(1 for p in privileges if p["status"] == "active")
    
    return {
        "timestamp": "2026-09-07T16:00:00Z",
        "total_privileges": total,
        "status_counts": {
            "revoked": revoked_count,
            "scheduled": scheduled_count,
            "active": active_count
        },
        "privileges": privileges
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Check access privilege revocation status for offboarded employees"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        '--format',
        choices=['json'],
        default='json',
        help='Output format (default: json)'
    )
    
    parser.parse_args()
    
    data = check_privilege_status()
    
    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
